address: 161 Cuba Street, Te Aro, Wellington, 6011, New Zealand
bio: Occupying a large white building, Cuba Street's most famous – and most aptly named – eatery is hard to miss. The menu revolves around European dishes made using quality local ingredients. Come for brioche French toast, or green eggs 'n' ham for breakfast or brunch. For lunch or dinner, the 20-year-old classic Flo's fish pie, or Flo's classic beef burger made with house-ground Greenstone Creek beef are solid choices. Visit their website for booking details.
